messages:
Liam: Quick heads-up — QuietBay POC procurement pinged. They need the final order form + a clear signature routing. Any blockers on the MSA/DPA redlines?
Anya: Saw QuietBay's redline this morning. They've added a KMS/HSM attestation clause and swapped payment terms to Net60. We should push back on Net60 and avoid hard HSM guarantees.
Oliver: From POC side they want a temporary latency SLA called out so their infra team can sign off. Can we scope a POC appendix with targets rather than modifying the MSA?
Marie: Net60 is rough for Finance. We can escalate but prefer Net30 or 30% prepay + Net30. If Procurement insists on Net60 need RevOps sign-off.
Liam: Procurement also says they need a PO before countersign and they want DocuSign routing by tax ID. Do we have an HSM attestation doc to share?
Anya: We have a KMS attestation summary and a SOC2 pack. I'll prepare a sanitized attestation PDF. Legal recommends "reasonable commercial efforts" language instead of a binding HSM guarantee.
Oliver: For SLA wording the POC appendix can say: temporary POC latency target measured via Redwood Console (not a full SLA). That should be fine for their infra sig-off.
DevBot: doc uploaded: /shared/attestations/redwood-kms-summary.pdf
Jake: QuietBay procurement wants the DocuSign envelope routed: QuietBay legal -> QuietBay exec -> Redwood Legal -> Redwood Revenue. Envelope must include PO number field. Any objections?
Anya: That routing is fine. Use redwood-esign@redwood.com for internal routing. Legal: we need to redact any internal proprietary schedules before sending.
Marie: Also, we need the billing contact and PO number on the invoice. If they require Net60 Finance will hold unless prepay or pre-approval.
Liam: I'll update the order form with an addendum offering a Net30 or 30% prepay + Net30 option and include a POC appendix. Oliver — can you confirm the latency target text?
Oliver: Confirmed proposed appendix text: ```Temporary POC appendix: Target (measured via Redwood Console) — p50 < 150ms, p95 < 500ms for sequence length <=1024 on provisioned trial capacity. Metrics will be visible in the per-route latency dashboard. This appendix is non-binding and valid only for the trial period.```
Anya: That reads OK. Swap "provisioned trial capacity" -> "provisioned trial capacity subject to availability" to avoid an absolute commitment.
Liam: Updated. Also QuietBay flagged SOC2 and EU data residency for logs. We can provide SOC2 report and enable region pinning for the trial in eu-west-1 with log redaction. Need eng to enable.
Oliver: Engineering note — we can enable region pin + log redaction flags for the trial customer; it's not automatic.
Liam: @eng-prod can someone flip region-pin for QuietBay trial?
DevBot: ticket created #ENG-8421 (region pin & trial redaction).
Jake: After countersign we need the invoice with PO and billing contact. Who will intake billing info from QuietBay?
Marie: Ask QuietBay to provide billing contact and PO number. In absence, Finance can't process Net60 without approval.
Liam: I'll ping QuietBay procurement now with: updated order form (Net30 / 30% prepay option), POC appendix draft, KMS attestation link, SOC2 link, and DocuSign routing steps. Will request billing contact + PO.
Oliver: I'll attach the finalized POC appendix to the order form when you send.
Anya: I'll review redlines once you upload the doc. Please remove any internal-only schedules before sending.
Liam: Cool. Sending now. Thanks all :thumbsup:
